references.phrase: category C with morphisms and identities
multiplicative system S of category arrows
references.context: Selected class of morphisms in a category, not a multiplicative subset of a commutative ring.
For each appropriate pair of arrows, there are commutative completion squares satisfying both sided Ore conditions.
Equality of certain composites can be resolved after pre- or post-composition with selected S-arrows, under the stated calculus-of-fractions axioms.

references.phrase: closure under composition and inclusion of identities
references.disposition: Two categorical structural closure conditions, independent of their ring-theoretic names.

review_rationale: Read identities and closure under categorical composition along with left and right Ore-square completion and cancellation axioms; distinguished arrows from ring elements.
